decision.title: string.h implemented in Phase 0
decision.summary: src/string.c implements include/sxml/string.h unchanged in Phase 0, fixing how decoding treats bytes that are not well-formed and when sxml_string_codepoint_at reports an index out of range.

body.p: , amending the last sentence of : src/string.c implements include/sxml/string.h unchanged, with 29 cases in tests/string_test.c (including an exhaustive check of all scalar values and of every lead/second byte pair against table 3-7). Choices the header leaves open: on bytes that are not well-formed, decoding stays within the view, decodes a byte that cannot start an encoding as itself, and decodes a truncated encoding from the bytes present; sxml_string_codepoint_at returns SXML_STATUS_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE when the bytes run out before the index, and takes the ASCII fast path only when the index is also below . compare and equals work on bytes (). Validation is a plain byte loop; a word-at-a-time ASCII scan can come later without an interface change.
